Net amount corresponding 3.915,33. Also further down for Netto-Einkauf II (Entgelt) there's "Umsatzsteuer 630,42 630,42" presumably VAT on purchase side with net 3.152,11? Need to map schema: Vat.Item array expects Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount for VAT groups applicable to entire invoice. Rules: "Exchange rates" irrelevant. We must only include exchange rates applicable to entire invoice — none.

We must determine which VAT group(s) to include:
- The invoice shows overall VAT 20% on "Brutto-Verkauf" with Netto-Verkauf 3.915,33 and Umsatzsteuer 783,42 (20% of 3.915,33 ≈ 783.066 — rounding gives 783,42 consistent with document). So one VAT group: Rate=20, Net.Amount=3915.33, Vat.Amount=783.42.
- There is also "Umsatzsteuer 630,42" related to "Netto-Einkauf II (Entgelt) 3.152,11" — this appears under purchase-side VAT (maybe input tax). It's shown as positive 630,42. 20% of 3.152,11 = 630.422 → 630,42 matches. Is that a separate VAT group to include? Schema allows multiple Vat.Item entries. Both VAT amounts are applicable to the entire invoice totals section, so include both groups. For each Vat.Item we need Vat.Rate (number without %), Net.Amount (number), Vat.Amount (number). So two entries with Rate=20 for both.
- Confirm no other VAT rates present: "Mehrwertsteuerkennzeichen: 2=20%" indicates only 20% used.

No inference policy: Use only exact text values converted to numeric with preserved decimals (dot decimal). Convert comma decimals to dot. Keep same decimal places as input: input shows two decimals, so use two decimals.

Potential ambiguity: Sender.VatId choice between ATU22642807 and ATU14398702. Evidence: "Ihre Daten:" likely recipient; footer company EDUSCHO (Austria) GmbH has UID ATU14398702 in footer and header lists EDUSCHO (Austria) GmbH at top — so sender is EDUSCHO and Sender.VatId = "ATU14398702".

Net.Amount and Vat.Amount mapping:
- VAT group 1 (sales): Net.Amount = 3.915,33 → 3915.33; Vat.Amount = 783,42 → 783.42; Vat.Rate = 20.
- VAT group 2 (purchase/input): Net.Amount = 3.152,11 → 3152.11; Vat.Amount = 630,42 → 630.42; Vat.Rate = 20.

GrandTotal.Amount check: Endbetrag 3.782,53 equals Netto-Einkauf II (3.152,11) plus taxes difference? Regardless, use Endbetrag 3.782,53 → 3782.53.

Invoice.Date already determined.

No other required fields.

Edge cases considered:
- Could Sender.VatId be ATU22642807 if "Ihre Daten" refers to sender; but header shows EDUSCHO (Austria) GmbH at top left and "Ihre Daten:" with UID ATU22642807 likely recipient BÄKO Österreich. Footer clearly states EDUSCHO UID ATU14398702. Therefore choose ATU14398702 as Sender.VatId.
